subject.title: Feature request: Shareable cron job templates

question: Should ClawHub introduce a first-class, user-installable automation-template package type, including its review and scheduled-execution security model?
rationale: Current context does not establish an approved package format or safe install boundary for third-party cron jobs, so a code-level implementation would choose durable product and security policy by inference.

options.title: Sponsor a constrained automation-template design
options.body: Define the package schema, preview, trust/review, permission, secret, and explicit-confirmation requirements before implementation.

options.title: Keep cron sharing manual for now
options.body: Allow community examples through existing documentation or package descriptions without creating an installable scheduled-job surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a constrained automation-template design
recommendation.body: Define the package schema, preview, trust/review, permission, secret, and explicit-confirmation requirements before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work is the closest supplied history involving import and publication of shareable ClawHub content.
